<issue>
Token end position calculation incorrect for string literals

#### Description

When tokenizing SQL strings, the `end` position of string tokens is calculated incorrectly, causing issues with token position tracking.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from sqlglot.tokens import Tokenizer

# Test with simple string literal
tokens = Tokenizer().tokenize("'abc'")
print(f"Token: {tokens[0]}")
print(f"Start: {tokens[0].start}, End: {tokens[0].end}")
print(f"Expected end: 4, Actual end: {tokens[0].end}")

# Test with triple-quoted string
tokens = Tokenizer().tokenize("'''abc'")
print(f"Token: {tokens[0]}")
print(f"Start: {tokens[0].start}, End: {tokens[0].end}")
print(f"Expected end: 6, Actual end: {tokens[0].end}")
```

The end position should point to the last character of the token, but it's currently off by 2 positions.
</issue>
